concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-custom-payouts-on-demand-payouts-approve-cancel-payouts]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Transfers API review guide for pending on-demand payout approval/cancellation, 30-day expiry, batch endpoints and webhook states; approval is not bank receipt.
warnings: Approval authorizes continued processing; cancellation or 30-day inaction fails the pending request. HTTP 200 and authorised webhook state do not prove booked payout or bank receipt.
The source does not establish same-request retry or replacement-transfer rules after cancellation/expiry.
Examples are TEST v4 and show one approval required; this does not prove a universal review-count or independent-human-control policy.
